name: France
administering_agency: Ministère de l’Intérieur; sat at centres approved by the Chambre de commerce et d’industrie de Paris Île-de-France or by France Éducation international

format.notes: Multiple choice in French: knowledge questions and situational questions on the five themes of the civic training. 45 minutes at most.

exemptions.disability: A person whose disability or state of health makes it impossible to assess their knowledge can be excused, on a medical certificate; extra time can be granted for medical reasons.

official_study_material.title: Liste des questions de connaissance de l’examen civique
official_study_material.publisher: Ministère de l’Intérieur, Direction générale des étrangers en France

unverified.fee: Set by each approved centre; no amount on the pages read.
unverified.format.question_pool_size: The list of knowledge questions is published; its size was not counted.

recent_change.summary: A written civic examination replaced the assessment of civic knowledge at interview: in place from 1 January 2026, under an order of 10 October 2025 on its programme and organisation.

notes: The ministry publishes the list of knowledge questions; situational questions are not listed. No licence statement was read, so reuse is unclear.
